t: The Forge Steel Stainless Steel Magnetic Tray Set provides essential organisation and retrieval for small metal components. It is ideal for mechanics, engineers, and electricians working on vehicles, machinery, or electrical installations. Constructed from strong, polished stainless steel with a tough PVC-coated base, these magnetic trays securely hold nuts, bolts, and screws, preventing loss. The set includes a 125-630mm extendable magnetic pickup tool with a convenient pocket clip for easy access and retrieving dropped metal items in tight spaces, a 77mm diameter round magnetic tray, and a 64 x 93mm rectangular magnetic tray. This durable magnetic tool set ensures a tidy and efficient workspace.
b: Extendable Magnetic Pick-Up Rod with Pocket Clip
